AMGN.rationale: Amgen faces a deteriorating fundamental picture with multiple severe headwinds converging simultaneously. Q1 2026 showed alarming sequential declines: revenue fell 9.8% QoQ and EPS plunged 43.7% QoQ, while operating cash flow dropped 53.3% QoQ. The balance sheet is severely strained with total debt of $57.3B against only $9.19B in equity (debt-to-equity of 6.24x), and the company faces a potentially material IRS tax dispute for 2016-2018. Critical product franchises are eroding rapidly: Prolia/Xgeva sales plummeted 32% YoY in Q1 2026 due to biosimilar competition following patent expiration, and Enbrel sales fell 37% YoY. The FDA has proposed withdrawing Tavneos approval citing data integrity issues and 76 cases of drug-induced liver injury, threatening $2.4B in intangible assets. Valuation remains elevated despite the selloff, with P/E of 23.5x still at the low end of its 22.6-- P/B of  P/S of 4.9x remain rich for a company facing acceleratingating revenue headwinds. The stock has declineded 10% over the past quarter with no near-term catalystyst to reverse the negative trajectory. Rising interest rates (10Y Treasury at 4.57%) and a steepening yield curve further pressure the valuation for this capital-intensive, debt-laden business model.
